features: HIGH PAGE YIELD Printing on a budget? No problem! This high-capacity 12A toner cartridge delivers an impressive yield of up to 2100 pages (at 5% coverage), making it perfect for busy homes, offices, and schools. Print more and replace less often.

SEAMLESS COMPATIBILITY ✅ Engineered for a perfect fit, this cartridge works flawlessly with a wide range of printers. It is fully compatible with HP LaserJet 1010, 1012, 1018, 1020, 1022, 3015, 3020, 3030, 3050, 3052, 3055, M1005 MFP, M1319f MFP and Canon LBP 2900, 3000 series printers.

SUPERIOR PRINT QUALITY 📄 Experience professional-grade results on every page. Our premium toner powder ensures deep blacks, crisp text, and sharp graphics without any smudging or fading. Your documents will look clean and impressive from the first print to the last.

RELIABLE & EASY TO INSTALL 🛠️ Each GPS cartridge is built using high-quality components for maximum reliability and performance. Installation is quick and easy—just remove the protective seals and insert it into your printer to resume printing in minutes.

COST-EFFECTIVE SOLUTION ₹ Get the performance and reliability of an original cartridge without the high price tag. GPS offers a smart, budget-friendly alternative that helps you "Colour Your Dreams" without compromising on quality.
